instruction.text: Read and listen to the short story.

atoms.text: Juana loves being outside. She and her mum go for hikes in the forest. They wear backpacks and bring their own lunch. Her mum tells her about plants and trees.
atoms.sound: ssml: The Woodpecker. <break time='1000ms'/> Juana loves being outside. She and her mum go for hikes in the forest. They wear backpacks and bring their own lunch. Her mum tells her about plants and trees.

atoms.a: Which is an event that has happened?
b: ++Juana and her mum pack a lunch.
Juana wants to go to the beach.

atoms.text:
“Mum, why is there a hole in this tree?” asks Juana.
“Well, there could be a few reasons,” answers her mum. “Let’s try to work it out!”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='f4_2025'> Mum, why is there a hole in this tree?</voice>asks Juana.<voice voice='f3_2025'> Well, there could be a few reasons</voice> answers her mum.<voice voice='f3_2025'> Let’s try to work it out!</voice>

atoms.text: Juana and her mum walk around the tree. They look for signs on the ground. They look up in the tree. Maybe there is a hint in the branches.
atoms.sound: ssml: Juana and her mum walk around the tree. They look for signs on the ground. They look up in the tree. Maybe there is a hint in the branches.

atoms.a: Which is an event that has happened?
b: Juana’s mum explains why rocks have moss on them.
++Juana and her mum try to work out why there is a hole in the tree.

atoms.text:
“How high is the hole?” asks Juana’s mum.
“Pretty high!” answers Juana. “Could it be a bird?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='f3_2025'> How high is the hole?</voice>asks Juana’s mum.<voice voice='f4_2025'>pretty high</voice> answers Juana.<voice voice='f4_2025'> Could it be a bird?</voice>

atoms.text: “Juana, I think your are right! I think it is a woodpecker. They use their beaks to make holes in trees. Then they can live inside.”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='f3_2025'>Juana! I think you are right! I think it is a woodpäcker. They use their beaks to make holes in trees. Then they can live inside.</voice>

atoms.text: “So this tree is home to a woodpecker!” says Juana. “It’s so fun to be outside.”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='f4_2025'> So this tree is home to a woodpäcker!</voice>says Juana.<voice voice='f4_2025'> It is so fun to be outside.</voice>

atoms.a: Which is an event that happened?
b: ++They discover the hole belongs to a woodpecker.
They go home and make spaghetti for dinner.
